title: Ne and he in standard Finnish
focus: Use he for people and ne for non-human referents in neutral standard writing.

exercises.prompt: Choose the sentence that means “They (the non-human referents) are here.” During a phone conversation. The previously named referents are dogs. Use standard written Finnish.
exercises.explanation: Standard written Finnish normally uses ne for non-human referents.

Correct. Standard written Finnish normally uses ne for non-human referents.
“He” is the standard plural pronoun for people; use “Ne”, a plural nominative form for already identifiable non-human referents.
